Brief: Describe the Great Barrier Reef and the threats it faces. — about Environmental threats

Kept:
1. Climate change, pollution, crown-of-thorns starfish and fishing are the primary threats to the health of this reef system.
2. According to a 2012 study by the National Academy of Sciences, since 1985, the Great Barrier Reef has lost more than half of its corals with two-thirds of the loss occurring from 1998 due to the factors listed before.
3. In 2022, the northern and central parts of the reef had the highest amount of coral cover since monitoring began, but the cover in the southern part had decreased and bleaching events occurred more frequently.

Already chosen: Crown-of-thorns starfish

- Coral
